text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Not long before Admire Vega runs in the Hopeful Stakes, Narita Top Road narrowly loses in her own debut race, despite being the favorite to win.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Admire Vega, who herself recently rose to the top of a pre-race popularity poll, is asked by Top Road if she ever feels pressured by the expectations of fans.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Admire Vega answers that she's determined to carry the burden she took on, and that resolve is what prevents her from wavering.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her heart full of that same resolve, Admire Vega heads into the Hopeful Stakes.
